series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction with weak seasonality. High model disagreement and detected concept drift suggest using a weighted combination strategy with dynamic error adaptation to account for changing model performance over time.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim1.0: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ade_dynamic_error is recommended for concept drift adaptation
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=-0.2982) → unstable rankings; inverse_rmse_weights with shrinkage is recommended for robustness
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge_stacking overfits with few windows
